reason: Дефект: гантель не поднята — оба блина стоят на полу в тех же местах, что в K0 (кадр почти совпадает с K0, SSIM 0.918); изменилось только выражение. Кульминация «хвост один поднимает вес» в K1 отсутствует, а C с first+last тянет движение к K1 — без исправления C не покажет подъём. Лапы с медалью у подбородка и хвост на центре грифа — в порядке.

Use accepted K0 as the first reference for the staged camera, room, dumbbell, navy-ribbon gold medal and hand positions. The actual ending of the opening is the second reference for the real prop and creature; the original design is the third identity reference. Keep the same tactile stylized 3D materials and warm lighting, vertical 9:16.

This is the unmistakable climax. The SINGLE attached tail alone supports the center of the SAME horizontal dumbbell, lifting its weights a modest distance clear of the wooden floor. The two forepaws still hold the ONE gold medal at the upper chest near the chin. Both paws are completely visible, clearly above and away from the bar. A broad empty gap separates the paws from the load. No other part of the body supports the dumbbell. Show the continuous tail path and its single firm wrap. Hind feet are planted.

The creature has just seen the real winner: eyes widened, former pride gone. Its gaze shifts between the powerful tail and the medal it was holding for itself; it turns slightly toward the helper. The tail's low effortless lift contrasts with the owner's earlier strain. Preserve the exact existing bar and plate assemblies, anatomy and face. No overhead lift, paw-to-bar contact, extra tail, extra medal, text or explanatory graphics.

Targeted correction for this frame: in the previous attempt the dumbbell still rested on the floor, so the climax was missing. Now the weight must be visibly OFF the floor. Both plate assemblies hang clearly in the air with an open strip of wooden floor beneath each plate, about one third of a plate diameter high, and a separate soft shadow on the floor under each plate. The bar is level and raised to about the creature's knee height. The tail's single wrap at the exact center of the bar is visibly taut and lifted, and it is the only thing holding the weight; the hind feet stay planted, the legs and body do not touch the bar. The two forepaws stay high at the chin holding the medal ribbon, with a wide empty gap above the raised bar. Keep the widened, surprised eyes looking at the lifting tail. Same room, camera, light, creature, medal and dumbbell.
